the ﬁrst model independent evidence of DM particles and with the determination of their properties.

the study of the DM particle nature and of its properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, on the basis only of the DAMA experiments and the exploited annual modulation technique, there is evidence of DM particles in the gallic halo, while the other experiments, with the exception of CoGeNT, are still far to reach the sensitivity to the DM signal.
the evidence for DM particles obtained by DAMA is robust, model independent, and has a high statistical signiﬁcance.

, after more than 20 years, the DAMA experiment, in particular with the results obtained with the DAMA/LIBRAs, is the only one which has got evidence for the presence of DM particles in the gal- lactic halo.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, over a period of about 25 years, we have developed the ﬁrst and the most stringent model independent DM annual modulated signal in the 2 – 6 keV energy region and have accumulated a total exposure of 2.46 ton × yr, with 2.0 ton × yr collected in the last 6 annual cycles, corresponding to the present running phase of the DAMA/LIBRa experiment.

the DAMA experiment is the most sensitive one to DM particles in the galactocentric frame, and the only one with a model independent evidence for the presence of DM particles, in agreement with the general expectations.

the DAMA/LIBRAs results, being model independent and obtained by exploiting the annual modulation signature, are robust and not in contrast with the other experiments, as it can be seen in the ﬁgure of the exclusion plots.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the DAMA/LIBRa results, obtained with an experiment with a long standing and well established history, are in agreement with the expected DM annual modulation signature and no systematic or side reaction has been found or even suggested by anyone over a long period.

, if the DM particle is a WIMP with a mass of 10 GeV, the DAMA/LIBRAsignal is compatible with the expected signal from the CDM model, with the correct value of the local DM density, and with the results from the other DM searches.
